images.name: 809-clay-render
images.prompt:
Generate one fresh square 1024x1024 image from text only. Use case: stylized-concept.
Style is the overriding priority: an untextured gray clay 3D modeling preview, a beautifully sculpted bust-and-body figure at a gray table. Every single surface has precisely the same uniform neutral-gray matte clay material, including skin, eyes, hair, glasses, sweater, coffee, cup, croissant, table and backdrop. All tonal variation comes only from lighting, geometry and soft ambient occlusion. No colored materials, no painted textures.
The large central sculpture depicts a woman in her early 30s, with abundant shoulder-length sculpted curls, round tortoiseshell-shaped glasses and subtly indented freckles. Her identity has auburn hair and a mustard-yellow knit sweater, but these are rendered entirely in gray clay. Knit stitches are sculpted into the sweater geometry. She holds a coffee cup with a relaxed, contented expression; a sculpted croissant rests nearby on the gray tabletop.
Composition: a three-quarter view of the seated upper body, hands and tabletop, enough body visible to feel like a substantial digital character sculpture. Soft studio HDRI, gentle contact shadows, subtle gray seamless background, readable chunky curls and clay glasses. Authentic digital sculpting presentation, not a photograph converted to grayscale. No text, caption, interface, signature, watermark or border.

images.name: 810-rice-paddy-art
images.prompt:
Generate one fresh square 1024x1024 image from text only. Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Japanese tanbo art: an actual enormous portrait planted in a flooded rice paddy, photographed from a high drone in bright summer daylight. A wide aerial landscape, looking steeply down over the full field. The entire portrait must consist of real living rice plants in varieties with deep purple, yellow, white and green leaves, arranged in dense planted rows and organic areas. Reflective water is visible between rice clumps. Tiny farm roads, field berms and small rural Japanese houses at the edges establish gigantic physical scale.
The picture planted across almost the entire field depicts a woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length curly hair, round tortoiseshell-shaped glasses, freckles, a knit sweater, and a coffee cup held close in enjoyment. Her auburn hair is interpreted through purple and warm yellow rice; her mustard sweater through golden yellow rice with planted stitch motifs. A crescent-shaped croissant is also part of the planted picture near the cup. Large simplified graphic shapes make her readable from the drone, with each shape visibly composed of rice plants.
The woman is the crop artwork, not a real person standing in a field. Flat planted shapes follow the field plane and aerial perspective. Natural farm detail, green surrounding landscape, summer sunlight. Not a printed banner, not paint on grass, not a superimposed illustration. No writing anywhere, captions, signatures or watermarks.

images.name: 811-high-speed-flash
images.prompt:
Generate one fresh square 1024x1024 image from text only. Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Harold Edgerton style high-speed flash photograph: an astonishingly crisp fraction of a second frozen by a microsecond strobe. Pure pitch-black featureless studio background. The central visual event is coffee erupting from a tipped cup in a complex sharply defined crown of liquid, with individual spherical droplets and thin splash membranes sparkling in sharp specular light. Flaky croissant crumbs are suspended sharply in midair, and the croissant itself is visible nearby in her other hand.
A woman in her early 30s fills the frame in a tight, dynamic, off-center head-and-chest shot. Curly auburn shoulder-length hair frozen mid-swing in airborne arcs; freckles; round tortoiseshell glasses; mustard-yellow knit sweater. She had been enjoying a coffee and is now caught startled by the splash, with eyes wide and head recoiling slightly. One hand grips the tilted coffee cup in the prominent lower foreground. Place her startled face higher and farther back, splash spreading diagonally through the foreground. Convincing human anatomy and physical liquid behavior.
Hard laboratory strobe lighting separates hair, face, droplets and sweater from absolute black. Razor-sharp motion-free details, rich color, no motion blur, no trails, no collage or multiple exposure. Authentic high-speed scientific photography with strong visual drama. No text, captions, signatures or watermarks.

images.name: 812-gond
images.prompt:
Generate one fresh square 1024x1024 image from text only. Use case: illustration-story.
An authentic Gond painting from central India, bright acrylic colors on a plain warm off-white background. The style fully controls anatomy and spatial arrangement: bold flat outlined figures, rhythmic organic curves, decorative profile forms, no optical perspective or realistic shading. Every colored figure, branch, bird and animal is filled throughout with meticulously hand-painted repeated fine dots, short dashes, parallel contour lines and fish-scale patterns, with distinct pattern rhythms in different areas.
A large stylized woman occupies much of the painting, seated in a freely elongated full-body profile pose beside an intricately branching tree of life with patterned birds and animals. She is in her early 30s, has curly auburn shoulder-length hair expressed as rhythmic rust-red patterned spirals, freckles expressed as fine cheek dots, and round tortoiseshell-colored glasses. Her mustard-yellow knit garment becomes an uninterrupted field of fine repeated dashes and curved bands. She joyfully lifts a small patterned coffee cup. A clearly recognizable crescent croissant rests on a small flat decorative plate nearby.
Interlock woman and tree into one flowing folkloric composition while keeping both readable; strong vermilion, mustard, forest green, turquoise, deep blue and black accents. Slight visible acrylic and paper character, patient hand-painted linework, rich ornamental detail, plain background showing around silhouettes. This is a flat traditional painting, with stylized anatomy, never a photograph with a filter or a 3D scene. No text, captions, lettering, signatures or watermarks.
